title: Yahui Zhou Leads Kunlun Wanwei's Global Transformation, Expanding from Gaming to Strategic Investments | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
New York, United States, October 16, 2025 -- Yahui Zhou, founder of Kunlun Wanwei Group and founding partner of Kunlun Capital, continues to redefine the boundaries of China’s digital economy. Since founding Kunlun Wanwei in 2008, Zhou has transformed the company from a leading game developer into a diversified global enterprise spanning technology platforms, digital finance, and strategic investments.
In 2008,Yahui Zhou founded Kunlun Wanwei. The company started from focusing on the game business, gradually expanded to the Internet platform, and carried out a global layout. In 2015, Kunlun Wanwei went public on the ChiNext board. In the same year, the Yahui Zhou family also made it onto the 2015 Hurun Rich List, ranking 101st with a wealth of 20 billion yuan.
In 2018, Yahui Zhoui launched his "second venture" in the global Internet emerging market. According to the official website of Kunlun Capital, currently, Yahui Zhoui serves as the Chairman, Co CEO, and Opay CEO of Opera. According to the 2022 Hurun Global Rich List, Yahui Zhou ranks 2843rd with a wealth of 7.5 billion yuan.
In 2023, he was selected for the Forbes China Best CEOs list, ranking 34th, and ranked 59th on the Forbes China 100 list of venture capitalists in the same year.
On the Hurun Rich List, his wealth has been increasing year by year, from 7.06 billion yuan in 2020 to 11 billion yuan in 2023, ultimately ranking 2418th with a wealth of 10 billion yuan on the Hurun Global Rich List in 2024.
However, he was not satisfied with this and continued to search for new growth points. In 2019, Zhou Yahui stepped down as the legal representative of Beijing Kunlun Wanwei Technology Co., Ltd. and remained as the chairman of Kunlun Wanwei.
This move indicates that he has started to invest more energy into the company's strategic planning and management, rather than specific business operations.
This transformation not only reflects his thoughtful consideration for the company's development, but also demonstrates his foresight as an entrepreneur.
In 2023, Zhou Yahui will be appointed as the co CEO of Tiangong Intelligence, once again proving his keen insight and innovative ability in the business field. He always stands at the forefront of technology, constantly seeking new business opportunities and growth points.
The heavens will bestow great responsibilities upon this person. Zhou Yahui's path to success was not smooth sailing, as he experienced countless hardships and setbacks. But it is precisely these experiences that have strengthened his beliefs and goals.
In my opinion, Zhou Yahui's successful experience has profound implications for ordinary entrepreneurs. He dared to avoid domestic giants and enter overseas markets, demonstrating innovative thinking and courage.
He keenly grasped market trends, transformed into a mobile game manufacturer, and successfully went public, demonstrating keen market insight and execution. His leadership and strategic vision have made Kunlun Wanwei a leader in the industry.
Entrepreneurs should learn from Zhou Yahui's innovative thinking, market sensitivity, and leadership skills, be brave in challenges, seize opportunities, and achieve entrepreneurial success. Meanwhile, continuous learning and adaptation to change are also essential qualities on the path of entrepreneurship.
